title: BillingCreditSandboxGrantRequest
description: billing.credit-sandbox-grant-request@1: POST /internal/credits/sandbox/grants, synthetic credit for tests and staging. Billing answers only when BILLING_CREDITS_SANDBOX=1; the grant is a test transaction (D9). D10: the grant lands in the subject's sandbox credit account for the project (account kind usd_credit_sandbox, owner subject:project), and only a sandbox hold (billing.credit-hold-create-request@1 sandbox: true) draws on it; real Credits are never touched.

amount_nano_usd.description: Integer nano-USD (1e-9 USD), stored as a string.
